test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘E + F’ means ‘E is the father of F’ ‘

‘E – F’ means ‘E is the sister of F’ ‘

‘E × F’ means ‘E is the brother of F’

‘E ÷ F’ means ‘E is the son of F’

If ‘B – C + Z × G + Q’, how is C related to Q?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Sister
 Brother
 Son
 
 

 

Given: B – C + Z × G + Q

It means: B is the Sister of C, C is the Father of Z, Z is the Brother of G, and G is the Father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9e3bf0f817258196d9b4e7160cfcf8f0f29ef4a9d83fa98d1f93b2afd563e87.png] 

So, C is the '**Father’s Father**' of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
